description: This file is a Node.js script written in ECMAScript modules that manages build and runtime procedures for a TypeScript-based project. It contains functions for determining if a build is necessary, reading and writing build stamps, handling source file relevance, and orchestrating the build process including invoking a TypeScript build script and executing the main application logic. The script also includes utilities for monitoring source changes, checking git status, and managing build dependencies.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Replaces all backslashes with forward slashes in a file path.

methods.name: isIgnoredSourcePath
methods.description: Checks if a source path matches test or helper files that should be ignored.

methods.name: isBuildRelevantSourcePath
methods.description: Determines if a source path is relevant for build based on file extension and ignoring test files.

methods.name: isBuildRelevantRunNodePath
methods.description: Checks if a given repository path is relevant for build considerations.

methods.name: isRestartRelevantExtensionPath
methods.description: Checks if a path is relevant for restart based on extension or specific metadata files.

methods.name: isRestartRelevantRunNodePath
methods.description: Checks if a path is relevant for restart purposes considering configuration, source, or plugin paths.

methods.name: statMtime
methods.description: Returns the modification time of a file or null if inaccessible.

methods.name: isExcludedSource
methods.description: Determines if a source file should be excluded based on its path relative to source root.

methods.name: findLatestMtime
methods.description: Finds the latest modification time in a directory, optionally skipping certain files.

methods.name: readGitStatus
methods.description: Reads Git status for watched paths to determine if sources are dirty.

methods.name: parseGitStatusPaths
methods.description: Parses Git status output to extract relevant file paths.

methods.name: hasDirtySourceTree
methods.description: Checks if the source tree has uncommitted changes or modifications.

methods.name: readBuildStamp
methods.description: Reads the stored build stamp JSON and metadata, returning modification time and head hash.

methods.name: hasSourceMtimeChanged
methods.description: Determines if source files have a newer modification time than the build stamp.

methods.name: resolveBuildRequirement
methods.description: Decides whether a rebuild is necessary based on environment, git status, build stamp, configuration files, and source modifications.

methods.name: formatBuildReason
methods.description: Converts build reason codes into human-readable labels.

methods.name: logRunner
methods.description: Logs messages related to build process if logging is enabled.

methods.name: runOpenClaw
methods.description: Spawns a process to run the main application, returning exit code.

methods.name: syncRuntimeArtifacts
methods.description: Executes the post-build routine to sync runtime artifacts.

methods.name: writeBuildStamp
methods.description: Writes a new build stamp file with current build info and git head.

methods.name: runNodeMain
methods.description: Main orchestrating function that manages build decisions and runs the project accordingly.
